required_fixes: Origin chunked implementation: spec.json measurement_validity #5 and prereg Design require origin server to serve Transfer-Encoding: chunked (no Content-Length) for chunked conditions. run_experiment.py start_mock_server called as start_mock_server(origin_port, size_bytes, ct_name) with use_chunked default False for all 27 cells; origin therefore always sends Content-Length. Chunked framing is synthesized only by the reverse proxy (proxy->client leg). Fix: set MockOAuthHandler.use_chunked=True for CHUNKED-PASSTHROUGH and CHUNKED-CACHED cells and verify via result.json observations that chunked TE is observed on the upstream leg, not only downstream, before claiming full end-to-end chunked coverage.

Proxy cache HIT double-header: ReverseProxyHandler._proxy_request cache HIT path sends both Content-Length and Transfer-Encoding: chunked for CHUNKED-PASSTHROUGH/CHUNKED-CACHED (run_experiment.py:406 and 410). HTTP/1.1 forbids sending both. Current client (requests+urllib3 with decode_content=False) tolerates it and decompression still succeeds (0 errors), but framing is not spec-compliant. Fix: for chunked configs send only Transfer-Encoding: chunked on both HIT and MISS, remove Content-Length line on HIT chunked path.

PARENT_REF_HASHES dead code: run_experiment.py defines PARENT_REF_HASHES (27 hashes from parent) but C_DETERMINISM_ACROSS_PATHS recomputes determinism live via fresh mock_direct servers on ports 6100+ rather than comparing to frozen parent hashes. Either remove constant or assert byte-for-byte equality to frozen artifact and document which is the determinism ground truth, per parent handoff unknown #8.

Claim ceiling wording: report.md Interpretation and result.json observations claim 'Transfer-Encoding: chunked does not degrade discrimination' without qualifying that upstream origin->proxy chunked was not exercised. Revise to 'proxy->client chunked downstream' until origin chunked is implemented and re-measured.

validity_findings.finding: Origin never serves chunked despite frozen spec requirement. All 9 content conditions x 3 configs share a single origin per size that is started with use_chunked=False. Proxy synthesizes chunked for CHUNKED configs. Upstream chunked (origin->proxy reassembly) therefore untested; downstream chunked (proxy->client) is correctly tested and transparent.

validity_findings.impact: Hypothesis V1 (chunked TE transparent to decompressor) is supported for downstream framing; interaction failure where proxy fails to reassemble chunked upstream before decompression cannot be excluded from this data. Per spec decision_rule MEASUREMENT_INVALID clause 'chunked TE is not correctly applied (e.g., origin still sends Content-Length)' the packet is strictly MEASUREMENT_INVALID on upstream scope, but downstream measurement is valid and discriminating.

validity_findings.finding: Cache HIT for chunked configs sends both Content-Length and Transfer-Encoding: chunked, violating HTTP/1.1. Does not cause decompression failure in this harness (0 errors) but means observed chunked byte stream is proxy-synthesized, not origin-preserved, and may not match real CDN behavior where Content-Length must be stripped.
validity_findings.evidence: research/experiments/EXP-RUNTIME-35401995092/run_experiment.py:403-427 cache HIT block sends Content-Length at 406 then Transfer-Encoding at 410 for CHUNKED-CACHED/CHUNKED-PASSTHROUGH; MISS block correctly strips both at 451-453 before re-adding only chunked
validity_findings.impact: No impact on discrimination metric (all 540 requests succeed) but undermines fidelity claim about chunked TE handling fidelity to real CDN proxy.

validity_findings.finding: Discrimination 0.5 is a deterministic consequence of the 3-way error collapse mock design (no_auth/expired/invalid share identical bodies) combined with deterministic brotli quality 6 and padding to exact target sizes. Within-state all_same=true for all 27 cells confirms no stochastic variation. The environment can express the tested effect (decompression failure would drop discrimination or cause errors) but the 0.5 ceiling is a mock artifact, not a production ceiling, as stated in validity_notes.

claim_ceiling: Iterative decompression (brotli->gzip->identity looping max_depth=5) preserves decompressed body-only discrimination at 0.5 (threshold >=0.3) through a localhost Python reverse proxy when the proxy forwards Transfer-Encoding: chunked to the client (proxy->client leg only) in both PASSTHROUGH and AUTH-AWARE CACHED modes (URL+Accept-Encoding+Authorization cache key, Cache-Control: private, Vary: Authorization). Validated only for: localhost 127.0.0.1 mock OAuth2 origin (Flask/stdlib, brotli quality 6 deterministic), 3 content types (JSON/HTML/XML) x 3 uncompressed sizes (1KB/10KB/100KB) x 4 auth states (no_auth, valid_token HS256, expired_token HS256, invalid_token) x 5 reps seed 44 jitter 50-150ms, N=540, Python 3.12.14. Upstream origin->proxy chunked, real CDN infrastructure (Cloudflare/Fastly/Akamai), Accept-Encoding negotiation, multi-layer brotli, binary content, and production-scale concurrency remain untested. The double-header artifact and origin-not-chunked limitation require fixes before claiming end-to-end chunked TE coverage.
